interface Account {
  id: number;
  owner: string;
}

type AccountId = number | string;

enum Currency {
  USD,
  EUR,
}

abstract class Repository<T> {
  abstract find(id: AccountId): T;
}

class AccountRepository extends Repository<Account> {
  private cache: Map<AccountId, Account> = new Map();

  find(id: AccountId): Account {
    const existing = this.cache.get(id);
    if (existing) {
      return existing;
    }
    throw new Error("not found: " + id);
  }
}

function describe<T extends Account>(account: T): string {
  return `account ${account.id} owned by ${account.owner}`;
}
